description:
1. Administrative Operations & Document Management
* Manage and supervise the filing, storage, maintenance, and retrieval of company documents and records.
* Establish and maintain administrative procedures to ensure accurate, consistent, and efficient document management.
* Oversee incoming and outgoing correspondence, official documents, and internal communications.
* Review and prepare administrative documents, reports, notices, and business correspondence when required.
* Ensure confidentiality, accuracy, and timely handling of company information and documents.
2. Office, Store & Warehouse Administration
* Oversee the management of office supplies, office equipment, and operational supplies for the head office, warehouse, and retail stores.
* Monitor inventory levels, arrange procurement, and ensure supplies and equipment are available and properly maintained.
* Coordinate purchasing and payment processes for store and warehouse goods in collaboration with relevant departments.
* Manage payment requests for office, store, and warehouse expenses, including electricity, water, internet, and other administrative costs.
* Monitor administrative expenses, review supporting documents, and ensure payments comply with company policies and approval procedures.
* Work with suppliers and service providers to ensure service quality, cost efficiency, and timely delivery.
3. Team Management & Process Improvement
* Supervise, assign, and monitor the daily tasks of the administrative team to ensure timely and accurate completion.
* Provide guidance, coaching, and support to team members to improve work quality and productivity.
* Establish work priorities, monitor team performance, and provide feedback to team members.
* Develop and improve administrative procedures, workflows, and internal controls to enhance operational efficiency.
* Identify administrative issues and propose practical solutions to management.
* Ensure the team complies with company policies, procedures, and service standards.
4. Internal Coordination & Stakeholder Management
* Act as a key coordination point between the head office, warehouse, retail stores, and other departments.
* Work closely with Finance, Accounting, HR, Procurement, Warehouse, and Retail Operations to resolve administrative matters.
* Handle and follow up on administrative requests and operational issues to ensure timely resolution.
* Coordinate company events, internal activities, meetings, workshops, and other employee engagement initiatives.
* Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders and external partners.
5. Reception & Meeting Support
* Oversee reception services and ensure professional support for visitors, customers, business partners, and suppliers.
* Coordinate meeting room arrangements, meeting materials, and other logistical requirements for meetings and events.
* Ensure reception and meeting support services meet the company’s professional standards.
6. Reporting & Expense Control
* Prepare regular reports on administrative operations, procurement status, expenses, and team performance.
* Monitor administrative budgets and expenses, identify cost-saving opportunities, and recommend improvements.
* Ensure administrative payments and purchasing activities are supported by appropriate documents and approvals.
* Maintain proper records for audit, reconciliation, and management review purposes.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the line manager.
requirements_text:
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Management, or a related field.
* At least 3–5 years of experience in Administration or Office Management , with proven experience supervising or leading an administrative team.
* Strong knowledge of administrative operations, procurement coordination, expense control, document management, and office services.
* Experience supporting multiple business locations, such as head offices, warehouses, and retail stores, is an advantage.
* Fluent in spoken English; proficiency in spoken Chinese is an advantage.
* Good communication, coordination, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Strong organizational, planning, and time-management skills.
* Detail-oriented, proactive, responsible, and capable of handling multiple tasks and priorities.
* Good leadership skills, with the ability to supervise, motivate, and develop team members.
* Able to work independently and collaborate effectively with different departments.
